messages:
maria: Heads up — the KB article 'kv-cache tuning' has a dead external citation (the 'Efficient KV Cache for LLMs' link). Clicking it returns 404. Can someone with edit rights either rehost a snapshot or swap to a canonical redirect? Link: https://openpapers.example/kv-cache-efficacy -> 404. cc @liam for page ownership :eyes:
liam: Thanks — good catch. I own that page. I'll check whether we have a local snapshot or an alternate canonical (arXiv/DOI). Maria, do you have any cached copy?
maria: I don't. I did find a webcache copy at https://web.archive.org/web/20230101/https://openpapers.example/kv-cache-efficacy but not sure about policy. Happy to open a tiny PR if you want.
liam: Open the PR with the web.archive.org URL as a temporary fix, and add a TODO comment to rehost the PDF in our KB assets. I'll review. Pinging @sophia for legal ops on the snapshot vs rehost question.
sophia: Quick legal note: linking to a Wayback snapshot as a citation is acceptable short-term, but preferred long-term is to host an author-permitted copy in our kb-static bucket or link to arXiv/DOI if available. If it's paywalled, we should link the DOI and note access restrictions. I can reach out to the authors if needed.
liam: Cool. I'll open the PR. For the immediate swap you can run: `sed -i 's|https://openpapers.example/kv-cache-efficacy|https://web.archive.org/web/20230101/https://openpapers.example/kv-cache-efficacy|g' docs/kv-cache-tuning.md` — that'll update the citation quickly.
maria: :thumbsup: also FYI CI smoke tests flagged that page's sample cURL snippet (job 1432) — output mismatch. If you're editing the file, can you either fix the snippet or add a short test exemption with a note?
liam: Will include a small snippet fix and add a test allowlist entry (commenting why) in the PR. Opening now — PR #4123: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
docs-bot: deploy-bot: PR #4123 opened by liam — requested reviewers: maria, sophia.
aj: If you end up rehosting the PDF, please put it under the kb-static bucket path `https://kb-static.redwood.com/attachments/kv-cache.pdf`. I can grant upload perms — ping me and I'll add you.
liam: Thanks @aj — will DM for upload perms. Assigning to myself to land the quick fix today (ETA EOD).
maria: Perfect, thanks all :sparkles:
